newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhenhai to issue US$200 mln convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhai to issue US$200 mln convertible bonds.

text.p: Zhenhai Refining & Chemcial Co Ltd said on Sunday it would issue US$200 million of bonds convertible into the company's H shares.

The net proceeds of the issue would be used to finance its expansion programme, which would allow the company to increase its refining capacity to 12 million tonnes a year in 1997 and 16 million tonnes in 2004, it said in an annoucement.
Altantic Richfield Co and its subsidiary, ARCO Asia Pacific Investments Ltd, had conditionally agreed to subscribe a substantial portion of the bonds to be issued, it said.
It gave no details on how much the U.S. company was going to subscribe.

ARCO already owned 237.6 million Zhenhai H shares, or 9.9 percent of the issued capital. If the bonds acquired by ARCO and other bondholders were converted into H shares, ARCO would own approximately 20 percent of the enlarged share capital of the Zhenhai, it said.
The convertible bonds issue would be subjected to approvals by the shareholders and from relevant Chinese and Hong Kong regulatory bodies, it added.
